card.name: Partway through medical condition phrases
card.fires_on: The first or middle piece of a multi-part medical condition term, just before the rest of the term, such as 'hep|atic' before adenomas, 'a|ortic' before aneurysms, or 'post' before herpetic or myocardial.

modes.label: Inside organ adjectives
modes.description: Responds to the end of a split organ adjective right before the disease noun.
modes.example: Rupture of hep<<atic>> adenomas may cause death through intra-ab

modes.label: Prefix or qualifier before condition
modes.description: Responds to 'post', 'vascular' or 'artery' that modifies a condition name coming next.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage for<< Post>>herpetic Neuralgia The recommended dosage

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a multi-word diagnosis, when the rest of the disease name is still to come.
